summary: Iteration 93 — backend-only verification of the iter257c dashboard task-counter scoping fix. Logged in via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL as admin@5812uganda.org and compared /api/dashboard/action-items and /api/dashboard/stats against independently computed MongoDB counts (mirroring deps.get_campus_filter + non-archived board scoping). Actual API response: {overdue_tasks:1, pending_approvals:0, expiring_passes:0, unassigned_tasks:4} and stats.tasks_overdue=1 — exactly the expected values. Pre-fix global (unscoped) overdue count in the same DB is 6, so the scoping fix is demonstrably effective. 14 pytest cases written; 13 pass, 1 documents a residual scoping gap (restricted/private boards).

minor.issue: Residual scoping gap: board scope uses only {is_archived != true, campus}, while GET /api/boards additionally hides is_restricted / is_private boards the user is not tagged on. Reproduced: inserted a non-archived restricted board in loc_001 with 1 overdue+unassigned task -> board correctly absent from /api/boards, but action-items jumped 1->2 overdue and 4->5 unassigned. Same class of phantom-count bug the user reported. Fix: reuse the /api/boards visibility resolution (or add is_restricted/is_private $ne true unless tagged_members/created_by contains the user) when building board_ids.

Dead sentinel: task_scope sets board_id to the literal string '__no_boards__' when board_ids is empty, but both count queries are already short-circuited with `0 if not board_ids`. Harmless but misleading — drop the sentinel.

Unassigned predicate only matches assignees [] or missing; assignees: null or ['']/legacy `assignee` field would be missed. No such docs in the preview DB today (all 9 tasks have list-type assignees), so no observed impact.

action_items: Optional (recommended): also exclude restricted/private boards the user cannot see when computing board_ids in dashboard.py, so counters exactly match what /api/boards exposes.
Optional cleanup: remove the '__no_boards__' sentinel in task_scope and broaden the unassigned predicate to also treat assignees:null / legacy `assignee` as unassigned.
critical_code_review_comments: Board-visibility logic is now duplicated in three places (deps.get_campus_filter, boards.list_boards, dashboard board_ids). Extract one helper e.g. `async def visible_board_ids(user)` in deps.py and call it from both boards.list_boards and dashboard.py — otherwise the two views will drift again (already drifted for restricted/private boards).

stats.tasks_overdue uses due_date {$lt, $ne:''} while action-items uses {$lt, $ne:'', $exists:True}; identical in effect but the duplicated query fragment should be a shared constant/helper to guarantee the two endpoints stay in sync.

success_rate.backend: 93% (13/14 assertions passing; the 1 failure is the documented restricted-board scoping gap)

seed_data_creation: Only transient docs inside tests (TEST_QA_board_iter93 / TEST_QA_restricted_iter93 / TEST_QA_board_iter93_other and their tasks), all deleted in finally blocks. Verified DB has zero leftover TEST_QA_* boards/tasks and admin.active_campus_id is still loc_001.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview DB: 1 non-archived board (board_3e7f60e2, loc_001) with 9 tasks -> 4 open, 1 overdue, 4 unassigned. Admin has active_campus_id=loc_001 so campus filter narrows to loc_001 + sub-locations. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iter93_dashboard_task_scoping.py (run with -p no:xdist). The single failing test test_restricted_board_tasks_not_counted is intentional and will pass once restricted/private boards are excluded from the dashboard board scope. Note: admin without active_campus_id still returned scoped values (no cross-campus leak observed) because a default active campus is resolved server-side.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: dashboard task counters queried db.tasks globally, so tasks on archived/deleted boards and other campuses were counted (6 overdue globally vs 1 truly visible). The fix (board_ids = db.boards.distinct('id', {is_archived:{$ne:true}, ...campus}) then board_id:{$in:board_ids}) resolves this — verified by injecting an archived-board overdue task and an other-campus overdue task, neither of which moved the counters. Remaining leak is only for restricted/private boards, which the dashboard scope does not filter out even though /api/boards does.
